Record an original performer or use original formant synthesis for an ancient undead ruler: low, dry and resonant, intelligible as a character presence on small speakers. Create one slightly hollow downward nonverbal throat murmur; keep useful harmonics above the fundamental rather than relying on sub-bass. No sentence, word, chant, long growl, spooky reverb or imitation of Undertale recordings. Match the other three Pharaoh takes in level and register; allow runtime +/-6% pitch variation. Deliver 1 distinct take, each 0.095 seconds long including decay. This is a single event, not a loop; do not add a second event or a montage. No intelligible words, dialogue sentences, music, background ambience or unrelated actions. Use original recordings or synthesis; do not sample reference games, copy recognizable character voices, or imitate a named performer. Export WAV, signed PCM 16-bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, peak no higher than -1 dBFS. Judge short sounds by peak and perceived loudness; do not force an integrated LUFS target. No leading dead air; preserve designed decay and 2-5 ms click-free edge envelopes.
